# Issue labels

| Label | Colour (hex) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bug | `d73a4a` | Something does not work as expected. |
| device-request | `a2eeef` | Support is requested for a screen model. |
| testers-wanted | `7057ff` | Owners are needed to test a change on their hardware. |
| needs-hardware | `fbca04` | Progress needs access to the affected hardware. |
| needs-info | `d876e3` | More information is needed from the reporter. |

Aim for a first reply within 48 hours. Review open issues each week.
Close a needs-info issue after 14 days without a reply. Reopen it when the missing details arrive.
